title: IEEE RAS mission and vision
text: The IEEE Robotics and Automation Society says its mission is to foster the development and facilitate the exchange of scientific and technological knowledge in robotics and automation for the benefit of members, the profession, and humanity. Its vision is to be the most recognized and respected global organization in robotics and automation. RAS advances innovation, education, and fundamental and applied research.

title: Robotics and automation field of interest
text: IEEE RAS describes robotics as systems with sensors and actuators that operate autonomously or semi-autonomously, often with humans, with emphasis on intelligence and adaptability in unstructured environments. Automation emphasizes efficiency, productivity, quality, and reliability, often in structured environments over extended periods.

title: IEEE RAS membership programs
text: IEEE RAS is a volunteer-driven society with more than 19,000 members worldwide. Its membership page highlights collaboration and information exchange with peers, communication of recent technological developments, career development possibilities, and access to leading publications including Robotics & Automation Magazine, Transactions on Robotics, Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering, and Robotics and Automation Letters.

title: Student Activities Committee
text: The IEEE RAS Student Activities Committee, formed in 2006, represents students in robotics worldwide. It organizes activities, promotions, and competitions to recruit students and keep members active. It supports student training, careers, professional relationships, networking, interdisciplinary dialogue, and robotics education.

title: IEEE RAS publications
text: IEEE RAS publications provide a global platform for researchers, engineers, and practitioners to share advances and applications in intelligent systems. The portfolio includes Transactions on Robotics, Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering, Transactions on Haptics, Field Robotics, Medical Robotics and Bionics, Robot Learning, Soft Robotics, Robotics and Automation Letters, Robotics and Automation Magazine, and Robotics and Automation Practice.

title: Conferences and workshops
text: IEEE RAS conferences and workshops support the advancement of robotics and automation research through interaction with professionals, expert panels, tutorials, short courses, exhibits, and social events. The RAS site identifies ICRA, CASE, and IROS among its major conference resources.

title: Robotics and automation standards
text: The IEEE RAS Standing Committee for Standards Activities works with research, industry, and standards organizations to identify robotics and automation areas suitable for standardization. Its objectives include common measures and definitions, measurability and comparability, and the integrability, portability, and reusability of robotics and automation technology.

title: Examples of active standards projects
text: The public active-project list includes work on robot task representation, 3D map data, ethically driven nudging, verification of autonomous systems, robot agility, human-robot interaction terminology and study design, semantic maps, and modular frameworks for robotically assisted surgical systems. Project status can change, so the live source should be checked.

title: IEEE RAS at the VIT Chennai IEEE Student Branch (historical page)
text: A public VIT Chennai IEEE Student Branch page describes IEEE RAS as advancing the theory and practice of robotics and automation engineering and science while maintaining high professional standards. The page also says the broader student branch organizes events, workshops, hackathons, and project labs. The listed team and statistics are from an older page and should be treated as historical, not current leadership information.

title: RAScade Hackathon by IEEE RAS VIT Chennai
text: The public RAScade page describes RAScade as an international 36-hour hackathon organized by IEEE RAS VIT Chennai. It links to the chapter's Instagram, a RAScade website, and Devfolio. Event registration status is time-sensitive and should be verified on the linked official pages.

title: VIT Chennai chapter initiative (historical document)
text: A public VIT Chennai chapter initiative document reports that the IEEE Robotics and Automation Society VIT Chennai Student Branch Chapter was inaugurated on 7 August. This is historical chapter material; it should not be used as evidence for current officers, current recruitment, or current events.

title: IEEE RAS Code of Conduct
text: IEEE RAS states that its activities should provide safe, productive, and welcoming environments for members, conference participants, staff, vendors, and volunteers. It welcomes respectful debate while prohibiting inappropriate, disruptive, abusive, or discriminatory behavior.
